_help: Weapon types. Poses are in the hero's model space (forward -Z, right +X, metres): h = hand position, d = [yaw, pitch] of the weapon in degrees (yaw +90 = points left, pitch +90 = points up). Each attack: dur (s at speed 1), wind (fraction spent winding up), hit (fraction when damage lands), dmg (x weapon damage), arc (half-angle, degrees), range (m), knock, stun (s), up (knock-up speed), lunge (m), spin (degrees the body turns), finisher (true = combo finisher, boosted by finisher passives), keys = [wind-up pose, mid-swing pose, follow-through pose]. Scaling: base 5 + str/dex/mag x attribute + item damage, times dmg. onHit = status chances per hit.
_a35Types: A-35 (2026-11-27, not play tested): the types colossal, colossalaxe, colossalhammer (two-handed, slow, long, hit hard and break poise: data/tuning.json game.poise.weapon) and twelve unexpected items, each its own type with its own feel: pan, broom, ladder, door, anchor, lamppost, fish, chair, cittern (lute), torch, spade, pitchfork. drop 0 = never from ordinary weapon rolls: they come only from data/weapon_finds.json (named finds by enemy, chest, shop, pedlar, fishing). Hand poses are borrowed from the type named in keysFrom.

kitModels._help: Twin Realms kit weapon models (assets/models/kit/weapons/<name>.glb). byName: weapon type -> base item name (data/items.json weaponNames; the longest name found in the item name wins) -> models it may show, as name or [name, scale]. Among those, elementModels picks the ones that suit the item's element (an Ember Sword picks sword_ember). Each item gets a stable size variation of +-sizeJitter; its element tints metal by elementTint. An item with a Model field shows that model. use = false: the built-in meshes everywhere. Not used (no matching type yet): shields, crossbow, chakram, claws.
kitModels._a35Help: A-35 (2026-11-27): colossal classes (colossal, colossalaxe, colossalhammer) and unexpected items (pan, broom, ladder, door, anchor, lamppost, fish, chair, cittern, torch, spade, pitchfork). Models: tools/blender_gothic/weapons_grand.py (colossal_*, dune_reaver_sun, giant_axe_storm, starfall_maul_void, seal_hallowed, siege_ladder), tools/blender_gothic/import_props.py (ph_* from Poly Haven, odd_* from Poly Haven / Poly Pizza, all CC0, see assets/ASSETS.md). Named finds and where they drop: data/weapon_finds.json.

size._help: A-11 item sizes. Every rolled weapon gets a size factor between min and max (two rolls averaged, so the ends are rare), saved on the item. It scales the model and the swing together: reach x (1 + (size-1) x reachPer), arc x (1 + (size-1) x arcPer), swing speed x (1 - (size-1) x speedPer) (longer = slower). names: [up to this size, word shown on the item]; '' = no word.
size._grandHelp: Every weapon drawn bigger so weapons read grand and heavy (the owner, 2026-11-27: weapons looked small): melee models x grandScale, bows / wands / crossbows / thrown x grandScaleRanged, the pickaxe unchanged; melee reach x grandReach so swings land where the bigger blade is. 1 / 1 / 1 = the old sizes.

dual._help: A-12 dual wield (a one-handed weapon in the off-hand slot instead of a shield). aspdP: +% attack speed while dual wielding. offDamageMul: the off-hand weapon's hit x this. staminaMul: basic attacks cost x this. Guard held with two weapons = crossed blades: guardReduction is the share of a blocked blow that is stopped (a shield stops 55% or more), parryWindow the seconds after raising the guard in which a blow is parried (shield: game.guard.parryWindow 0.15). offAnims: attack animations (data/avatar.json attackAnims) the off-hand swings cycle through; [] = each step's own animation.

unarmed._help: No weapon equipped: fists. Short reach, quick, light hits that scale with Strength. Combo jab > cross > hook (attacks.json style unarmed).
unarmed.name: Fists

sfx._help: Sounds per event (scripts/Sfx.cs Weapon): swing = attack start, shoot = ranged release, hit = the blow or shot lands, miss = a melee swing that connects nothing / a shot that hits no foe. Each entry: id (an Sfx id: a file assets/audio/sfx/<id>_N or a synthesized sound), vol, pitch [min, max] (random in range). A type without a list plays the generic sound and logs a warning once.

rapier._help: A-11 new weapon types (compact). keysFrom = borrow another type's hand poses; light / heavy = feel class; icon = inventory icon; drop = loot weight; affinity = class id -> +% damage with this type; shot = the missile of a thrown / mechanical ranged type {kind, speed, powerSpeed, life (s), lift, pierce, powerPierce, powerShots, powerSpread, aoe}.
rapier.name: Rapier
